 ORDER

This second application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.316/2022 registered at Police Station Kirnapur District Balaghat, for the offence punishable under Sections 21(1), 21(2), 21(3) of Animiyat Jama Yojna Pratibandh Adhiniam, 2019 and Sections 420, 467, 468, 120 B, 201 and 406 of IPC.
Earlier application of the applicant was rejected on merit vide order dated 14/11/2022.

Counsel for the applicant submits that role of the applicant in the alleged crime is very nominal; he has been made accused only because he has collected the amount from the persons who intended to invest the amount so as to get the same doubled.
He submits that it is the main accused who assured the investors to pay the double amount invested by them and applicant is not beneficiary.

He was Sevak Ram Balle vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159161039/
1 only agent of those persons who have floated the scheme.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that one of the accused facing same allegation i.e Mukesh Meshram has been granted bail by this Court and applicant is in jail since 22/09/2022.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, counsel for State has opposed the submissions made by counsel for the applicant and submitted that the present applicant had played an important role in the alleged crime.
He issued forged cheques of other persons.

He further submits that bail application of other co-accused persons have already been refused by this Court and the order on which applicant is relying was passed by this Court in some other crime i.e Crime No.445/2022.
He prayed to reject the application of the applicant at this stage.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of this case, role played by applicant in the alleged crime and allegation made against him, this Court does not deem it appropriate to grant bail to the applicant, at this stage.
Accordingly, the same is hereby rejected.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE sushma Sevak Ram Balle vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159161039/
